=== CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:224-236 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The new `.github/ai/` overlay is not gated on `--tests-file` and has no kill switch or feature flag, so it changes the PR-tree snapshot on every wrapper call (implement, review autofix, conflict resolver and heal gates).
  WHY: Callers that never pass the flag now see PR-tree copies of top-level `.github/ai/*` files, which can change how tests pass, fail and are classified; this contradicts "Existing callers and the default path are unchanged" and the fragments' claim "Existing callers and consumer repos see no change unless they pass the flag", and neither the agents.d nor the changelog.d fragment mentions the overlay. All reviewers rated it MAJOR.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:224-236 | severity=critical | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: The overlay copies tracked top-level `.github/ai/*` files into `${root}/source` with `install -m 0644` and skips the `allowed()` filter in scripts/review_untrusted_workspace.py (lines 131-154: the secret/credential name checks, the `.github/` subtree rejection at line 152 / `dot_github_subtree` at line 96, and the allowlist of only `.github/ai/claude_engine.json`).
  WHY: An untrusted PR test can read a file such as `.github/ai/foo_secret.json` and print it into a failure tail that the wrapper copies into `out_dir/result.json`. Severity disagreement: gemini BLOCKER; minimax, luna and glm MAJOR; sonnet NIT. Sonnet did not confirm exfiltration, because the unfiltered merge-base baseline (lines 205-208, mounted at line 240) already exposes those copies, and treats the issue as undocumented scope and a declared-vs-effective filter gap.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:606-607, 673, 813-820 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: When a `--tests-file` `::name` entry names a test the PR added to a file that already exists on the merge-base, the baseline re-run fails with pytest exit code 4/5 (node not found / no tests collected). `_run_one` maps that to "fail", and `classify_baseline` (line 820) counts the unit as inherited.
  WHY: parse_tests_file merges all names for one path into a single unit, so one new node ID makes every PR-caused failure in that file count as inherited. `pr_caused` can then be empty and the gate can return `status: pass` on a real regression, which breaks "keeps `classify_baseline` semantics". test_tests_file_runs_listed_files_and_names_on_both_trees does not cover this case.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:584-621, 1418-1436 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: parse_tests_file accepts `::name` for every `is_test_file` path, but plan_units drops the names for `.sh` (`["bash", path]`), for JS runners (jest/vitest/mocha/npm test), for script-style `.py` run without pytest, and for the `prepush_test_command` override (`{files}` receives paths only).
  WHY: An entry such as `tests/example.spec.js::test_x` runs the whole file or the broader command while the log reports `outcome=loaded`, and the caller gets no signal that its filter was ignored. Severity disagreement: sonnet NIT; gemini, minimax, luna and glm MAJOR.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1524-1527 | severity=low | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, z-ai_glm-5_3-flash]
  PROBLEM: `if args.command == "run" and args.tests_file:` tests for truthiness, so a direct module call with `run --tests-file ""` falls through to `_selection_from_args` and runs the normal affected-test selection.
  WHY: This contradicts "An explicit test list never falls back to the affected-test selection". The wrapper rejects an empty value with usage_error (lines 145-150), so only direct module calls are affected. Fix: `args.tests_file is not None`, which yields `tests_file_unreadable`.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:160-164 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: When `stat -c %s` fails, `tests_file_size` is empty; the regex check then fails and the synthetic result says `tests_file_too_large`.
  WHY: A file that is unreadable or vanished is reported with a misleading reason instead of `tests_file_missing` or `tests_file_unreadable`, so the operator gets the wrong next-action hint. (sonnet raised the same point as a hardening suggestion.)
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:188-191 | severity=low | confidence=1
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The `install -m 0444` copy of tests.txt is checked only through install's exit code, so a copy that succeeds but is truncated would not be caught.
  WHY: The reviewer calls this theoretical: the file is capped at 256 KiB and the root has space.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:parse_tests_file 1398-1438, plan_units 606-607, _run_one 673, classify_baseline 814/820 | severity=MAJOR | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: When a `::name` test is added by the PR to a file that exists on the merge-base, baseline pytest exits 4 ("not found"); this counts as "fail", so the unit is inherited, and the merged names mean every PR-caused failure in that file becomes inherited.
  WHY: Regressions the heal runner reproduces are reported under `inherited`, `failures` stays empty and the gate can pass; the new test uses only names present on both trees. Fix: ignore baseline rc 4/5 for units with `::` targets, or drop names absent from `_python_test_functions(baseline / path)`.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1420-1434, 609, 611, 612-621 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: `::name` is accepted on `.sh`/JS/script-style `.py` paths and logged as `outcome=loaded`, but the name is dropped and the whole file or the whole `npm test` / `make test` runs.
  WHY: Failures in sibling tests that were not listed appear in `failures`/`inherited` with no signal to the caller. Fix: reject the name with `tests_file_name_unsupported`, or document the behaviour.
- workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py:1524 | severity=NIT | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `run --tests-file ""` is falsy and falls through to `_selection_from_args`.
  WHY: Contradicts "never falls back to the selection"; only direct module calls are affected (the wrapper rejects it at 147-150). Fix: `args.tests_file is not None`.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:224-236 (+ tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 870-871) | severity=MAJOR | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: The unconditional `.github/ai/` overlay changes the PR-tree snapshot for every existing caller; review_untrusted_workspace.py excludes these files (line 152, `dot_github_subtree` line 96).
  WHY: This is an undocumented change to default behaviour, outside the issue's scope, and it contradicts both fragments ("no change unless they pass the flag"); it may fix the test_orchestrate_lib.py false positive, but it should be moved to its own change or documented.
- scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh:224-236 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The overlay widens the snapshot beyond the `allowed()` filter (lines 131-154, which admit only `.github/ai/claude_engine.json`) with no guard, and the change is not recorded.
  WHY: Header step 4 (lines 13-14) guarantees credential filtering, so a future secret-named `.github/ai/*` file would skip the name checks; the content risk is low because the baseline is already unfiltered. Fix: apply the filter's name checks in the loop and update the header and the fragment.
- Note: SECURITY: NONE. The pass-1 claim that the overlay leaks secrets was not confirmed: lines 205-208 extract the merge-base tree unfiltered into /baseline, which is mounted at line 240.
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "`scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh`: add `--tests-file <path>`. ... Existing callers and the default path are unchanged." and "Stay inside the listed files, use append-only edits".
  Expected change site: scripts/prepush_test_gate_run.sh, limited to `--tests-file` plumbing.
  Evidence of absence: The unconditional overlay at lines 224-236; the existing wrapper test was changed to assert it (tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py lines 855, 870-871); the fragments do not document it. SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
- TASK_GAP: Requirement: "`--tests-file` runs exactly the listed files and `::name` entries on both trees and keeps `classify_baseline` semantics."
  Expected change site: tests/test_prepush_affected_tests.py + the baseline re-run handling for named units in workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/prepush_affected_tests.py.
  Evidence of absence: No test covers a `::name` entry that exists only on the PR tree, and that case is misclassified as inherited. SEVERITY: MAJOR, ISSUE_CONFIDENCE: 4
